about.title: About Le Canot à Pixels
about.lead: A retro video game catalogue, rooted in Lavaltrie, Québec.
about.body1: Le Canot à Pixels ("the pixel canoe") takes its name from the legend of the chasse-galerie, the flying canoe of a tale deeply tied to Lavaltrie. This site showcases my Xbox and Xbox 360 game collection: the data comes from a PriceCharting CSV export, transformed into a browsable catalogue.
about.body2: Images are, first and foremost, my own photos. When none exist, a reference cover may be shown; the actual item may differ.
about.sourceBody: Core information (title, console, reference value, condition) is imported from PriceCharting. Site-specific statuses, sale prices and notes are managed locally.
about.disclaimerBody: The values shown are reference values from the imported data and do not constitute a guaranteed selling price.
